subject: Promo credits not posting to dashboard
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@betaapps.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, support@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Promo credits not showing on dashboard

Hi Marissa / Redwood support team,

We signed up yesterday using the promotional code REDFREE23 that was listed on the signup page for startups. The signup completed successfully, but the free credits balance on our dashboard shows $0.00. We also received the welcome email, and the coupon field showed as applied during checkout.

Account details:
- Company: BetaApps Inc.
- Signup email: nora@betaapps.io
- Account ID (appears in URL): betaapps-1546

I've attached a screenshot of the dashboard and the confirmation email. Can you confirm whether the credits were issued and, if not, apply them? We're planning a spike this week and would like to use the promo credits.

Thanks,
Nora
Senior PM, BetaApps
[Attachment: screenshot-credits-dashboard.png]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@betaapps.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Promo credits not showing on dashboard

Hi Nora — thanks for flagging and for the screenshot. Sorry for the friction here. I've opened an internal ticket (RBC-4591) and looped in engineering.

Quick checklist for us to confirm on your side if possible:
- Did you use a company credit card at signup? (I know rare cases change flow)
- Can you confirm the exact promo code shown on the UI at signup (you mentioned REDFREE23)

Aditya / Laura — can you take a look at RBC-4591? Tentative ask: confirm whether the coupon redemption event was recorded in the signups table and whether the async credits ingestion job ran for account betaapps-1546. Nora is hoping to get access to the credits this week.

Nora — I'll update you within the day with next steps or a temporary manual issuance if needed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 16:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Promo credits not showing on dashboard

FYI — I dug into RBC-4591 this morning. Root cause appears to be a race between the self-serve coupon redemption webhook and the credits ingestion batch. The redemption event was written to signups but the ingestion job skipped betaapps-1546 because the account creation timestamp fell just inside a boundary window we recently tightened for performance.

Plan of action:
1) I'll run a one-off credits issuance script to credit the account with the $100 promo amount immediately (ETA: within 2 hours of this mail).
2) I'll add a guard to the ingestion job to handle boundary timestamps and add a reconciliation step to catch similar misses (deploy in the next release).
3) I'll post the reconciliation run and results to the RBC ticket and the internal runbook link.

No PII exposure here — just an event ordering bug. Will share logs in RBC-4591.

— Aditya
Senior Engineer, Serving Runtime
[Attachment: log-snippet.txt (truncated)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@betaapps.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Promo credits not showing on dashboard

Hi Nora — quick update: thanks for your patience. We applied the $100 promotional credits to BetaApps (account betaapps-1546) manually and you should see the balance reflected after you sign out and refresh the dashboard. I attached the manual-credits-receipt.pdf for your records.

What we changed: engineering ran a one-off issuance and will deploy a reconciliation fix this week to prevent recurrence.

If you still don't see the credits after a refresh, reply here and I'll escalate immediately. Sorry again for the disruption and thanks for flagging it early — we want to make the onboarding experience smooth.

Best,
Marissa Cole
